summary: This 6-K filed by Central North Airport Group (OMA) announces the payment date for the first installment of a previously declared cash dividend. The total dividend is Ps.4,900 million, paid in two equal installments of Ps.2,450 million or Ps.6.280254872 per share each, with the first payable on May 27, 2026 to holders of record on May 26, 2026. The dividend was approved at the Annual General Ordinary Shareholders Meeting on April 24, 2026. The filing is a routine capital return event, not a special situation such as a restructuring or delisting. Watch for the second installment payment date on November 30, 2026.
